metadata.question: Was the concentration of tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) over Los Angeles lower between October 1-23, 2021 compared to the same period in 2019 and 2018?

data.exec_msg:
Period: Oct 1-23
Los Angeles Tropospheric NO2 (mol/m^2)
2021 Mean: 1.399e-4, Pixels: 874
2019 Mean: 1.326e-4, Pixels: 874
2018 Mean: 1.313e-4, Pixels: 874
2018-2019 Average: 1.319e-4
Evidence: 2021 NO2 concentration is not lower than the 2018-2019 average.
B
